entry.summary:
Modern microservice architectures improve scalability and team autonomy, but they also introduce a new challenge: service dependency failures. If one service becomes slow or unavailable, it can easily cascade across the system, bringing down multiple services. This is where the Circuit Breaker Pattern becomes extremely important. n8n is the better choice for most people. It has a modern visual editor, 400+ built-in integrations, active development, and a growing community.
